import type { StructuredListContract, StructuredListItem } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class StructuredList extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        toolbar: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        selection: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        sort: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    items: readonly StructuredListItem[];
    variant: string;
    toolbar: StructuredListContract['toolbar'];
    selection: StructuredListContract['selection'];
    sort: StructuredListContract['sort'];
    constructor();
    updated(): void;
    private choose;
    private content;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
